mcqs.question: Under the Andhra Pradesh Human Organ Transplantation Amendment Act 2026, which of the following is correct regarding tissues and the objective of the amendment?
options: Muscles are also included among tissues, and the amendment aims to promote transparency and stop trafficking.
Only skin and cornea are included among tissues, and the amendment aims to expand commercial transplantation.
Muscles are excluded from the definition of tissues, and the amendment aims to reduce transparency in transplantation.
Only bone marrow is included among tissues, and the amendment aims to permit organ trafficking.
mcqs.explanation: The amendment includes muscles among tissues and seeks to ensure transparency while stopping trafficking. The other options incorrectly alter the scope of tissues or the stated objective of the amendment.
